Not a cryptographic proof of absence or a scan of full public ancestor history. Third parent preserves untracked and possibly ignored files; original stash flags cannot be inferred from the object alone.

preservation_checks: Push the exact top stash commit under its proposed archive ref; retaining only a diff or the top tree loses stash topology and can lose third-parent files.
After push, compare remote ref OIDs with the recorded commits. In a separate fresh fetch/clone verify each parent commit and third-parent tree are available before dropping any stash.

A normal checkout of a stash archive branch does not materialize stash0 third-parent files. Restore deliberately using stash-aware recovery (git stash apply --index <archive-ref>) in an isolated checkout at the original base, or extract the third-parent files separately.

Preserve the three original local branch OIDs with archive refs before removing their local names. Counts of commits absent from gr-tdigest origin are not claims of global uniqueness across other repositories.
No archive refs/pushes, stash drops, cleanup, branch deletion or source changes were performed by this audit. Parent owns mutations.
